results.what: Sources: every wiki page used is saved with its url and licence, and the map credits the wiki
Facts: every fact the map rests on is a word-for-word quote from a saved page
Name: the map carries the wiki's own name and number for the level
Survival difficulty: the class and its lines are recorded as the page gives them
Description: the rooms look and read the way the page describes the level
Entities: the map's entity is one the page lists for this level, under the wiki's name
Resources: what there is to eat and drink is named as the wiki names it
Entrances and exits: you arrive the way the page says and the way out leads where the page says
Grounding: every line the players read cites a wiki quote, a rule of the mod, or both, as its kind asks
Nothing invented: no level, entity, object or name appears that the saved pages do not have
Playable: a route from the elevator to the exit exists, with a refuge and the game's food on the floor
Honest lines: no room ids or directions, a room only mentions what is in it and what the mod builds, nothing calls the map safe, and nothing speaks of hunger, rest or passing out
Mod contract: halls.lua reads exactly the lines listed in generator/text_keys.json
